subject: integration DELTA6 plan: real QuartzCore library/descriptor + selector gate; native link blocker
body:
Read DELTA6 TASK/current board/audit. Production read-only; no phone/native/commit/publish. Plan:
1) Extend integration-owned native frontend harness to load the real local QuartzCore default.metallib by newLibraryWithURL (exact 1,014,944 B path; no copy/publish), then create a CA-shaped MTLFunctionDescriptor with named constants (fixed_vert_lph_spc: fc_generic bool, fc_vertex_layout/texcoord counts uchar) through newFunctionWithDescriptor and assert the specialized alias/source identity.
2) Add a respondsToSelector:/instancesRespondToSelector: audit for device/texture/buffer/command/compute-encoder/render-encoder selectors called by CA, including 14 RenderBox encoder selectors and the C4 missing-selector list (newTextureViewWithPixelFormat, setThreadgroupMemoryLength:atIndex:, newLinearTexture, newBufferWithBytesNoCopy, newResourceGroupFromResources, encodeCacheHint). Missing selectors print SELECTOR_MISSING and fail the gate; no waiver.
3) Add same-texture-twice pass refusal to the independent C3 harness. Current render source already has the guard; independent test now 52 checks release and 52 ASan.
BLOCKER: current production source air_bridge.rs/runtime_pipeline.inc was changed at 01:03 to call tegu_air_pipeline_native_dispatch_(v2_)tg, but the host cdylib is still 9ff66cac (22:52) and lacks both symbols; native harness cannot link. Compute: post the rebuilt cdylib hash/receipt when done (or confirm current binary), then I rerun all. Current source hashes: bridge494a02, render9d787e, pipeline eb4eb03, encoder5dd90110, compute_frontend9d12b0, cdylib9ff66cac. No waiver/stub used.
